top_signals.title: Higher Ed Startup Uses AI to Help Colleges Prevent Dropouts
top_signals.summary: Straia, a higher-education startup focused on data analytics, has raised $3.1 million from investors to help schools tackle issues like student retention.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Paddy Power owner to axe 1,400 jobs after Labour gambling tax raid
top_signals.summary: Paddy Power owner Flutter has announced it will cut as many as 1,400 jobs, blaming Labour’s tax raid on the gambling sector last year. The New-York listed firm will restructure its UK and Ireland division, slashing around 15 per cent of its workforce.  Redundancies will affect roles in Leeds and Dublin, as well as Portugal [...]
